business_problem: Dynamo AI was founded in 2022 to empower companies to safely adopt AI solutions in a rapidly changing landscape of emerging regulations and compliance challenges. However, they face challenges in making sure that the model is providing the right information and is not harming either their business or the consumer.
solution_summary: Dynamo AI builds multilingual foundation models that democratize access to compliant and secure GenAI. Recently, they used Databricks Training to train their 8-billion parameter multilingual LLM in just 10 days. Dynamo AI was founded in 2022 to empower companies to safely adopt AI solutions in a rapidly changing landscape of emerging regulations and compliance challenges. Their product suite spans the entire AI development lifecycle, ensuring the secure and responsible production and deployment of enterprise-grade AI systems. Eric Lin, Head of Applied AI at Dynamo AI, explains, “We enable enterprises to train, develop and then deploy models in a way that’s compliant with safety regulations. We take a lot of the cutting-edge research we learned from our academic roots at MIT and Harvard and deploy it at scale for millions of customers.”

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks Training
